title: Proper-direct-image product comparison is inverse to compact-support Kunneth
statement:
Use the finite coefficient ring $A=A_{E,n}$ and normalized geometric constructible operations of [def-fix-six-functor-datum]. Let $p_i:X_i\to Y_i$ for $i=1,2$ be proper morphisms of separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $p=p_1\times_kp_2$, and let $M_i\in D^b_{ctf}(X_i,A)$. Write $r_i:X_1\times_kX_2\to X_i$ and $s_i:Y_1\times_kY_2\to Y_i$ for the projections. Let $\alpha_i:s_i^*Rp_{i*}M_i\to Rp_*r_i^*M_i$ be the ordinary exchange maps of these projection squares and $t_p:Rp_*B\otimes Rp_*C\to Rp_*(B\otimes C)$ the usual lax tensor map, the ordinary-adjunction transpose of the tensor of the two pullback counits. Define
$$\Pi^p_{M_1,M_2}:Rp_{1*}M_1\boxtimes Rp_{2*}M_2\xrightarrow{\alpha_1\otimes\alpha_2}Rp_*r_1^*M_1\otimes Rp_*r_2^*M_2\xrightarrow{t_p}Rp_*(M_1\boxtimes M_2).$$
With $R(-)_!=R(-)_*$ identified by the specified proper compactification, this is exactly $\mathrm{Ku}_!^{-1}$ for the compact-support Kunneth isomorphism of [def-sf-kv-maps](i). In particular it is an isomorphism with those canonical maps, not merely an unspecified isomorphism of the same objects. For the proper-direct-image comparison induced by a proper morphism of correspondences in [lem-trf-proper-direct-image-comparison], its map $\Pi$ of [def-trf-cohomological-comparison] is this $\Pi^p$ with $p_1=p_2=p_X$.
